name: hSpeed
meaning: horizontal drift per second at full strength (Emitter_UpdatePerfume 0x52ced5 mov eax,[edx]; imul g_dt)

name: vSpeed
meaning: vertical drift per second (0x52cef0 mov edx,[ecx+4])

name: range
meaning: vertical distance from the reference height over which the drift fades to 0: strength = (range - |ref - y|) / range (0x52cfab movsx edx,[ecx+0x14])
